verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility (swap base URL/key/model, 'two code changes') and ships official Python/Node SDKs, which is the standard mechanism agent frameworks use to plug in a provider, and community reports confirm real-world usage in coding agents (e.g. 'official support' for Cursor, a Coding Plan used for months, DFlash2 optimized for coding-agent speed). However there's no first-party guide naming specific agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGPT, etc.) and community evidence shows friction in some agent integrations (claude-code-router format/rate-limit errors, patchy Cursor integration historically). missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides for named agent frameworks beyond generic OpenAI-compat instructions, and resolution of documented integration friction.
